description: This Java class 'ExpectationDTO' is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for serializing and deserializing 'Expectation' objects within the mockserver project. It includes fields for request matchers, responses, callbacks, forwarding, errors, timing, and other expectation-related data, along with methods to build 'Expectation' objects from its data and vice versa.
